quarterly_data.quarter: AstraZeneca press release: Tezspire demonstrates positive Phase III results in (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Positive high-level results from the Phase III CROSSING trial of AstraZeneca and Amgen's Tezspire (tezepelumab) in eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE): both doses (subcutaneous every four weeks) showed statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvements versus placebo across both co-primary endpoints (histologic remission, defined as a peak esophageal eosinophil count of six or fewer per high-power field, and change in dysphagia measured by the DSQ) and all key secondary endpoints at week 24, sustained through week 52. The trial randomised 368 patients aged 12-80 years 1:1:1 to low dose, high dose or placebo; safety was generally consistent with the approved indications, and full results will go to regulatory authorities and an upcoming medical meeting. Tezspire has held US FDA Orphan Drug Designation for EoE since October 2021; the company says EoE affects more than 470,000 people in the US. EVP Sharon Barr said Tezspire has now shown clinically meaningful efficacy in a third epithelial-driven inflammatory disease. Tezspire is approved for severe asthma in the US, EU, China, Japan and more than 70 countries and for CRSwNP in the US, EU, China and Japan; the Phase III JOURNEY and EMBARK trials in COPD are ongoing, and more than 100,000 patients have been treated for severe asthma since 2021.
quarterly_data.figure: CROSSING both co-primary and all key secondary endpoints met at week 24, sustained through week 52 (high-level results); 368 patients; more than 470,000 US EoE patients; severe asthma approved in more than 70 countries; more than 100,000 patients treated

quarterly_data.signal: Tezspire collaboration economics as stated in the release: under the 2012 Collaboration Agreement (amended over time) AstraZeneca and Amgen share Tezspire costs and profits equally after AstraZeneca pays a mid-single-digit inventor royalty to Amgen; AstraZeneca leads development and Amgen leads manufacturing. Amgen records US product sales, with AstraZeneca recording its share of US profits as Alliance Revenue; outside the US AstraZeneca records product sales.
